caption: The drawing depicts a folded textile, likely a blanket or throw, with an intricate woven pattern. The fabric is primarily composed of deep indigo blue, bright red, and white hues. The main side of the textile is colored navy blue and covered with a repeating grid of small white and red plus-shaped motifs, interspersed with small dot patterns. Along two adjacent edges of the blue section, there are wider borders featuring white geometric and botanical-like linear designs. The textile has fringes along its edges in a mix of blue, red, and white threads. The corner of the textile is folded over, revealing the reverse side, which predominantly displays a red background with white, black, and red plaid checkered patterns, as well as small floral or star-shaped motifs. The fringe is visible on both the main and folded-over edges, contributing to the overall composition of the cloth. The background of the drawing is a plain, beige color with some visible shadowing around the textile.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
